CIRCUIT
Rounds: 8m
AMRAP #1
20 Pulse Squats
20 DB Plank Pull Through
10 DB half burpee row
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Left)

CIRCUIT
Rounds: 8m
AMRAP #2
10 Reverse Crunches
10 Narrow Squat, hammer curl, front raise
12 Narrow Stance Snatch
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Right)

"CIRCUIT"
Warm up: 

1. a. Pulse Squats 1 set of 20 reps
* AMRAP #1, Rounds: 8m
super set b. DB Plank Pull Through 1 set of 20 reps
super set c. DB Half Burpee Row 1 set of 10 reps
super set d. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Left) 1 set
rest 0:00 between each super set

2. a. Reverse Crunches 1 set of 10 reps
* AMRAP #2, Rounds: 8m
super set b. Narrow Squat, Hammer Curl, Front Raise 1 set of 10 reps
super set c. Narrow Stance Snatch 1 set of 12 reps
super set d. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Right) 1 set
rest 0:00 between each super set
